bio.text: Sam Park represents District 107 in the Georgia House of Representatives, to which he was first elected in 2016.

According to his legislative biography, Park is a native Georgian who earned a BA in political science and a BS in economics from Georgia State University in 2009 and a JD from Georgia State University College of Law in 2013.
The biography says he earned a Master of Laws from American University Washington College of Law in 2014 and worked as a bankruptcy litigator.
